description:
Presence/absence of a gene across the accessions of a crop pangenome: how many accessions carry it, core or
variable, which accessions lack it (and which carry it, if fewer), location, description and genome browser link.
gene: a pangenome gene ID, a B. napus Ensembl (Darmor-bzh v4.1: GSBRNA2T..., BnaA01g00010D) or BnIR ZS11 gene ID
(mapped to the pangenome gene), or words from the protein description (e.g. 'flowering locus C') to list matching
genes. B. napus genes come with their Ensembl v4.1 and ZS11 counterparts. A variable gene gets absence_context:
whether neighbouring genes are absent in the same accessions (a block suggests a real deletion or homoeologous
exchange; a single-gene absence may be divergence or low coverage), each absent accession's genome-wide absence
count against the median, and synthetic parents. Give the assessment with any absence. Datasets: 'bnapus' = B. napus pangenome (Darmor-bzh v8.1 plus 52 accessions, 94,013 genes; IDs like BnaA01g00010.1D2 for Darmor v8.1 genes and BnaPanG000163 for novel pangenome genes; chromosomes chrA01-chrA10, chrC01-chrC09); 'boleracea' = B. oleracea pangenome (TO1000 reference plus broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage x2, cauliflower x2, kale, kohlrabi and B. macrocarpa; IDs Bo1g001000.1 = Ensembl Plants B. oleracea gene Bo1g001000, novel genes BOLEPAN_00000379.1; chromosomes C1-C9 of the BOL assembly). The dataset is detected from the gene ID, chromosome or accession names when not given. Accessions have a 'form': bnapus Oilseed (24), Synthetic (20, resynthesized from B. rapa x B. oleracea, with parents), Fodder (3), Vegetable (2), Swede (2), Elite (2); boleracea broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, kale, kohlrabi, reference line, wild relative.
